_note: RITA voice scope (coder, Oct 23 2026). Gary 12:33 PM CT: "focus on voice lines that will actually be used in each section, realistic milestones". Read by tools/build_rita_voice.py. Only regions listed in build_regions get audio. A line key in text/overworld_lines.json system_company_voice that carries its own region tag ("region": "region_1" | 1, or "regions": [...]) is voiced iff that tag is in build_regions; an untagged key falls back to the bases listed under regions.<r>.keys (a base also covers its variants <base>_2.._<base>_9). Each new region adds its own block (keys + names + numbers). Text Bot owns the lines; this file only says which ones get a voice.

region_1.label: Region 1: Brookhollow, Trail 1 (route1), Fernwick, through Master 1 (beat_master_fernwick)

why.kilindex_new: Kilindex counts 2-4 (company_voice.json min/max_count); Gary's model line
why.kilindex_milestone_10: only reachable milestone: region 1 can log at most 18 kinds (17 Trail 1 wild species incl. tumbloam/rillop + cindrip if picked as starter; no creature gifts before Master 1). 25+ unreachable.
why.area_new: area-sign titles of brookhollow ('Brookhollow'), route1 ('Trail 1', system lines area_name), fernwick ('Fernwick'). Brookhollow fires on the first return after got_starter.
why.trainer_first_win: first trainer win (Trail 1 / Fernwick trainers); no slot
why.rival_beaten: beat_rival_ron_1 only (fernwick.ron_rival_1); {trainer} is always 'Ron' in company_voice.js
why.quest_done: the 15 built region 1 quests (zones brookhollow / route1 / fernwick, map_status built, not finale-gated); {quest} = quest title. Map-pending quests (sq_dana, sq_ron_job, sq_kid_joke, sq_over_the_wall, sq_missing_note) and mq_welcome_back (finale_done) left out.
why.first_evolution: GRIND-ONLY in region 1: every region 1 line evolves at L16 (placeholder), wild L2-4, Master 1 team L10/L12. Kept because it costs little and a grinding player would otherwise get a silent line; names = region 1 species that evolve by level + their next forms.
why.numbers: {level} (id_level_up, live since RT Employee Benefits raises company.idLevel): region 1 caps at ID 4, so 2/3/4 (Gary 5:22 PM CT Oct 23 2026: 'Trainer 1, your badge is worth more now' played silent, no clip for level 2). 5/10/15 kept for count thresholds.
why.names.node: board_node_4 {node} = cap(node id) from data/rt_benefits.json nodes (company_voice.js board emit); one clip per node, stitched by rita_voice.js like any name slot. {rank} 1-3 (max rank 3) -> numbers 1/2/3. Oct 27 2026 coder.
why.extra_lines: rita_trainer1 = TRAINER1_INTRO in src/systems/company_voice.js (code text, no overworld_lines key); it was in the shipped manifest, kept so rebuilds don't drop it. Must match the code text exactly.

skipped.kilindex_milestone: generic base: never picked while kilindex_milestone_<count> keys exist

region_1._unreachable_before_master_1_but_ungated: Fernwick's east exit (Thornwood) and west stub (Tide-Lock Road) have no story gate, so a player can log those area signs before Master 1. They are region 2 content here: their area_new plays text-only (no name clip) until region 2's block lists them.

rita_trainer1: Yeah, no. That uses too much company time. You're now Trainer 1.
